    Privacy policy

    Last updated: November 16, 2026

    This policy explains which personal data is processed when you visit codersite.dev, why, and what rights you have. I keep it short and specific: if something isn’t listed here, this site doesn’t do it.

    Who is responsible

    Moises Gamio, Berlin, Germany. The full contact details are in the Impressum. Email: codersitedev@gmail.com.

    Hosting and server logs

    This website is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc. (88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. St., San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). When you open a page, your browser sends technical data to GitHub’s servers, including your IP address, the date and time, the page requested, the referring page and your browser type. GitHub needs this data to deliver the website and to keep it secure, and may store it in server logs.

    Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in a secure, working website). GitHub may process data in the USA; it is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. More information: GitHub Privacy Statement.

    All scripts, styles and fonts of the blog itself are served from codersite.dev. The exceptions are the third-party services described below.

    Consent banner

    Visitors from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland see a consent banner from Google (Google’s consent management platform, which follows the IAB Transparency & Consent Framework). Google Analytics and Google’s advertising features only use cookies or similar technologies after you agree. Until then, Google tags run in a restricted mode that doesn’t store or read cookies.

    You can change or withdraw your choice at any time:

    Legal basis for storing and reading information on your device: § 25(1) TDDDG and Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent).

    Google Analytics

    With your consent, this website uses Google Analytics 4, a web analytics service of Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland). It helps me understand which articles are read, how visitors find them and which pages need improvement. Google Analytics uses cookies and processes data such as pages viewed, approximate location, device and browser information, and an online identifier. Google may transfer data to Google LLC in the USA; Google is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

    Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent). More information: Google Privacy Policy.

    Google AdSense and Google Ads

    This website shows ads from Google AdSense and uses the Google Ads tag to measure the results of my own ad campaigns. Both are services of Google Ireland Limited. With your consent, Google uses cookies and similar technologies to show ads, to limit how often you see them, to measure their performance and, if you agree, to personalise them based on your interests. Without consent, Google may show non-personalised ads, which don’t use cookies for advertising in the EEA.

    Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent). Third-party vendors and ad networks that take part in the IAB framework are listed in the consent banner. More information: How Google uses information from sites that use its services and Google advertising.

    Amazon affiliate links

    As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Many articles link to books and products on Amazon. These are affiliate links of the Amazon Associates program: if you buy something after clicking one, I receive a small commission. The price is the same for you.

    Nothing is loaded from Amazon until you click a link. When you click, you leave codersite.dev, and Amazon may set a cookie to record that you came from this site. I receive only aggregated reports about clicks and sales, never your name or what else you bought. Amazon is responsible for the data it processes: Amazon Privacy Notice.

    Legal basis for showing affiliate links: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in financing this website). The footer of every page repeats this notice.

    Referral links

    Some pages contain a referral link to MSIT / Masterschool. If you enroll in an eligible program through it, both you and I may receive a reward. Nothing is loaded from Masterschool until you click the link; after that, Masterschool’s privacy policy applies.

    E-book sales (Payhip)

    My e-books are sold through Payhip (Payhip Ltd, United Kingdom). On the book pages, a Payhip script is loaded to show the checkout window; this transmits your IP address and browser data to Payhip. If you buy, Payhip and its payment providers (for example Stripe or PayPal) process your name, email address and payment data to complete the order and send you the download link. I receive your name, email address and order details as the seller.

    Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performing the purchase contract). More information: Payhip Privacy Policy.

    Online shop (Spreadshop)

    Our shop page (codersite.dev/shop) embeds our Spreadshop (codersite.myspreadshop.de), which is operated by sprd.net AG (“Spreadshirt”), Gießerstraße 27, 04229 Leipzig, Germany. When you open the shop page, your browser loads scripts and content from Spreadshirt’s servers, and Spreadshirt receives technical data such as your IP address, browser type, the page you came from and the time of the request. Other pages of codersite.dev do not load the shop.

    Spreadshirt shows its own cookie banner on the shop page. Cookies that are necessary to run the shop and the basket are set on the basis of our legitimate interest in offering our merchandise (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Other cookies and technologies, such as analytics and marketing, are only used if you agree in Spreadshirt’s banner (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and § 25(1) TDDDG). You can refuse them and still use the shop, and you can change your choice at any time in Spreadshirt’s cookie settings.

    If you place an order, your contract is exclusively with sprd.net AG, not with codersite.dev. Spreadshirt processes your order, payment, shipping and returns, and the personal data required for them, under its own responsibility. More information: Spreadshirt privacy policy.

    Book landing pages and fonts

    The book pages under codersite.dev/book/ load fonts from Google Fonts (Google Ireland Limited). This transmits your IP address to Google. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (a consistent, readable design of the book pages).

    Donations (Buy Me a Coffee)

    The “Buy me a coffee” button is a plain link. Nothing is loaded from Buy Me a Coffee until you click it; after that, their privacy policy applies.

    Contacting me by email

    If you email me, I process your email address and the content of your message to answer you. I delete the messages when they are no longer needed, unless I have to keep them by law. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (answering your enquiry), or Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR if your message is about a purchase.

    Your rights

    Under the GDPR, you have the right to:

    • access the personal data I hold about you (Art. 15),
    • have incorrect data corrected (Art. 16),
    • have your data deleted (Art. 17) or its processing restricted (Art. 18),
    • receive your data in a portable format (Art. 20),
    • object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21),
    • withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7(3)), using the “Change privacy settings” button above.

    To exercise these rights, email codersitedev@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the Berlin Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit).

    California residents: I don’t sell personal information. You can ask me which personal information I hold about you and ask me to delete it by emailing the address above.

    Children

    This website is aimed at software developers and isn’t directed at children under 16. I don’t knowingly collect personal data from children.

    Changes

    I update this policy when the website or the services it uses change. The date at the top shows the latest version.
